It then cuts to a montage of Tim Walz: speaking passionately at a podium, raising his arm in victory while walking through a crowd, and clapping and smiling during a red, white, and blue balloon drop at a large event. A screen in the background of the balloon drop reads "2024". The video concludes with a graphic for a CBS News 'America Decides' Vice Presidential Debate between JD Vance and Tim Walz, scheduled for October 1st.
